draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Ettumanoor! The great Shiva temple here is one of the major Shiva temples in Kerala, and temple tradition says the Pandavas and the sage Vyasa once worshipped in it.
draft.hungryLine: Next door in Athirampuzha the old chantha, the vegetable market, still runs, so it's a good place to see what's fresh around here.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Go to the Ettumanoor Mahadevar Temple first, then over to Athirampuzha, 3 km away, for its old market and St. Mary's Forane Church.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Find a quiet corner in the temple grounds and take your time.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Marco Polo wrote about a trading town called Athiramkari, and its description closely matches Athirampuzha, just 3 km from here.

spots.name: Ettumanoor Mahadevar Temple
spots.detail: Short drive · One of Kerala's major Shiva temples

spots.name: Athirampuzha
spots.detail: 3 km from Ettumanoor · Old market town and home of Mahatma Gandhi University

legends.title: Shiva in eight forms
legends.body: It is believed that Lord Siva appeared here in eight different forms, which gave Ettumanoor its name. Another story says the name means the place of deer.

legends.title: Visitors from the epics
legends.body: Temple tradition says the Pandavas and the sage Vyasa worshipped here. Eight Brahmin families are remembered as the temple's original keepers.

tips.title: Catch the feast in January.
tips.body: St. Mary's Forane Church in Athirampuzha celebrates the feast of St. Sebastian every year on January 24 and 25.

tips.title: Visit the old market.
tips.body: The chantha in Athirampuzha that Marco Polo may have described still exists today.

story.title: An old village
story.body: Athirampuzha, just 3 km away, is believed to have been a well settled village even by 1200 AD.

story.title: A port called Athiramkari
story.body: Marco Polo described a trade centre called Athiramkari, famous for pottery, cattle, a vegetable market and cloth. Boats docked at Chantha Kulam, the centre of trade.

story.title: The great Shiva temple
story.body: Ettumanoor Mahadeva Temple became one of Kerala's major Shiva temples, named alongside Vaikom and Vadakkunathan. Its name carries stories of deer, eight families and eight forms of Shiva.

story.title: A university town
story.body: Mahatma Gandhi University sits in Athirampuzha, 10 km north of Kottayam. The January feast of St. Sebastian still draws big crowds.
